column1: # cwTools model sets: one row per file. Trust anchor for the installer: every file it installs
# must match the sha256 here (archives are only containers). Release assets: one archive per set,
# cwtools-models-<set>.tar.gz (+ .sha256), each < 2 GiB (GitHub's limit per release asset).
# default: p = installed by default for the plugin, l = for the plugin on Linux only (GPU models),
# m = for the plugin on macOS only (CPU models), s = for the Remote server, - = optional,
# r = with the plugin in every models mode, Remote-only (skip) too (small files the plugin itself
# reads, such as the SAM3 tokenizer for text prompts)
# family: Remote server model folder (- = plugin only). Refresh sha/size: make_package.sh --update-models-tsv DIR
